messages.content:
<ticket id="t011">
Our team of 12 uses Lumen daily. We would pay extra for a way to see who edited a note and when, like a version history with names. Right now we cannot tell who deleted a paragraph.
</ticket>

<category>feature_request</category>
<findings>
none
</findings>

Your task: Check the read tools for whether Lumen currently offers note version history, edit attribution (who edited and when), or deletion audit logs, and whether any plan or add-on includes them. Report the facts only.

Recently my advisor suggested that I reorganize everything by project rather than by date, and I would like to do this without losing the links between notes, because I use a lot of internal links to connect field observations with literature summaries. My question is: if I move a note from one notebook to another, do the links that point to that note keep working? And if I merge two notebooks, what happens to the comments and the edit history? I could not find a clear answer in the help center, and I do not want to try it on my real data first. content.text: Lumen's ticket data does not show whether it offers edit attribution or deletion audit logs. Two other tickets mention a version history and edit history, so some form of note history appears to exist, but no ticket says whether it shows who made each change. t055 asks for an audit trail export and t011 is the only ticket on this request, and none of the tickets say which plan or add-on would include these features. The read tools have no product or pricing catalog, so plan and add-on availability can't be confirmed from here.
